headlines.title: His Credit Card May Cover a Broken or Stolen Phone, as Long as He Pays His Phone Bill With It
headlines.summary: Your wallet may already hold a repair shop and a replacement phone, but one monthly habit decides whether it works. Miss it once and the protection can switch off, and lost phones fall into a gap many cardholders never see coming.

headlines.title: Capital One Software Recognized in KuppingerCole Analysts 2026 Leadership Compass for Data Security Platforms
headlines.summary: MCLEAN, Va., November 12, 2026--Capital One Software, the enterprise B2B software business of Capital One, has been named an Overall Leader in the KuppingerCole Analysts 2026 Leadership Compass for Data Security Platforms. Evaluating 21 leading solutions, the benchmark assessed vendors that combine data discovery and classification with protection, access governance, monitoring and compliance controls applied at the data layer.

headlines.title: Capital One Financial Blocks AI Agents, Bets on Premium Cards and Discover
headlines.summary: Capital One Financial (NYSE:COF) is investing in its payments network, premium card offerings and technology while maintaining flexibility to return capital to shareholders, Chief Financial Officer Andrew Young said at a conference.

description: Capital One Financial Corporation operates as the financial services holding company for the Capital One, National Association, which engages in the provision of various financial products and services in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. It operates through three segments: Credit Card, Consumer Banking, and Commercial Banking. The company accepts checking accounts, money market deposits, negotiable order of withdrawals, savings deposits, time deposits, and sweep accounts. Its loan products include credit card and personal loans; auto and retail banking loans; and commercial and multifamily real estate, and commercial and industrial loans. The company offers credit and debit card products; bank lending; and provides advisory, capital markets, net interchange, treasury management, and depository services. It serves consumers, small businesses, and commercial clients through digital channels, branches, cafés, and other distribution channels located in New York, Louisiana, Texas, Maryland, Virginia, New Jersey, and the District of Columbia. Capital One Financial Corporation was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in McLean, Virginia.
